We focus on jointly modeling both source code (PYTHON) and concomitant natural language documentation (docstrings) with transformers, through the study of dual tasks: generating method code bodies from signatures and docstrings, and generating docstrings from signatures and method code bodies.

In this work we focus on jointly modeling both source code (PYTHON) and concomitant natural language documentation (docstrings) with transformers, through the study of dual tasks: generating method code bodies from signatures and docstrings, and generating docstrings from signatures and method code bodies.
datasets: Our parallel corpus extracted from 118k GitHub repositories
outputs: Generated PYTHON code method bodies and natural language docstrings
The model generates Python method bodies from signatures and docstrings, and generates docstrings from signatures and method bodies in various styles such as one-line, Google, Numpy, and reST.
